newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia in $240 million wireless phone deal with AT&T.
newsitem.headline: Nokia in $240 million wireless phone deal with AT&T.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said Thursday it signed a three-year contract worth $240 million to provide AT&T Wireless Services Inc. with wireless telephones.
The phones can be used on either analogue or next-generation digital networks, Nokia said.

"This new phone will allow our customers the flexibility to travel to all of our markets and utilize our various networks seamlessly," AWS executive vice president Maggie Wilderotter said in a statement.

AT&T Corp. Wednesday introduced its new wireless service, which combines a phone, pager and personal messaging system in a single device that works across the country. The service is initially available in 40 major markets.
